answer: Ratify is a from-scratch Rust implementation of the Raft consensus algorithm with 68 passing tests, TLA+ model checking, and Porcupine linearizability verification. It reproduces 4 historical bug classes and is designed as a 3-node correctness project rather than a performance benchmark.
